statement: Intel guided second-quarter 2026 revenue of $13.8-$14.8 billion with GAAP gross margin of 37.5%, results due July 23, 2026.
why: Gross margin is the clearest read on whether a chipmaker's manufacturing is earning its keep; a level in the high thirties shows Intel's foundry build-out is still a drag rather than a profit engine.

impact.mechanism: Thin gross margin limits the cash Intel can reinvest in leading-edge capacity, slowing how fast it can become a credible second source of advanced manufacturing.

evidence.excerpt: second-quarter 2026 revenue of $13.8 billion to $14.8 billion

confidence.basis: Prior-quarter guidance restated inside a secondary-tier document rather than fetched from the earnings release itself; no cross-publisher corroboration.
